name: Social Disaster
summary: Social Disaster is a single-player satirical detective adventure set in Northbridge, a fictional city explored through its online world. Playing as Nori Byte, players follow digital trails through social media profiles, posts, articles, documents, recorded conversations and videos. By comparing accounts, identifying contradictions and connecting clues, they piece together what happened. Twelve fictional social platforms and an original music service also contain stories and media beyond the investigation.
